app_events.details: Rider R-7108 booked trip RYDE-DS-008 from Waterway Point to Sengkang General Hospital. Pickup 19:00.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'; GPS within 15 m of pickup point.
Driver cancelled. Wait counted from driver_arrived: 7 min 30 s. Rider did not reach no-show threshold; no fee applied.
Rider app location within 40 m of pickup point.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. The count is inclusive.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It covers rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: Wait is counted from the driver's arrival: the driver_arrived event is at 19:02:00 and he cancelled at 19:09:30, which is 7 min 30 s. This trip's policy sets the no-show threshold at 8 minutes, so the rider was not yet a no-show and no S$8.00 fee is payable. The driver's chat at 19:09:20 says '10 minutes', but the GPS shows he was still approaching at 18:59 and arrived at 19:02. The unanswered calls and the rider's late message do not move the clock.
